recipe.name: Bacon Jam
directions: Place the bacon in a large cold cast-iron skillet. Cook over medium heat until the bacon is browned and crisp, 5 minutes. Work in several batches, as needed.
Transfer the bacon to a colander set in a heatproof bowl and drain. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons bacon fat. (Reserve the remaining bacon fat for later use).

Return the skillet to the stove and heat over medium-high heat. Add the onion, and cook until lightly browned, 4 minutes, stirring with a wooden spoon. Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute.

Return the bacon to the pan along with the coffee, vinegar, syrup, molasses, brown sugar, pepper, and hot sauce. Stir well and gradually bring the mixture to a boil, stirring often. Lower the heat and gently simmer the mixture, uncovered, until thick and syrupy, 15 to 20 minutes, stirring often.
For a chunky jam, use as is. For a smoother jam, puree the ingredients in a food processor, running the machine in short bursts.

Serve the bacon jam at once, either warm or at room temperature. Or transfer to a jar, cover, and cool to room temperature. The jam will keep refrigerated for at least 3 days, but for the best results, let it warm to room temperature before serving.
